input.command:
cd /tmp/opencode/bench/log-analysis-kernel && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re, json, statistics
lines=open('server.log').read().splitlines()
pat=re.compile(r'^(\S+) (INFO|WARN|ERROR|FATAL) user=(\S+) route=(\S+) code=(\S+) latency=(\d+)ms msg="(.*)"$')
errs=[]; bad=[]
for i,l in enumerate(lines,1):
    m=pat.match(l)
    if not m: bad.append((i,l))
print("bad",len(bad),bad[:5])
recs=[pat.match(l).groups() for l in lines if pat.match(l)]
print("ts sorted:", all(recs[i][0]<=recs[i+1][0] for i in range(len(recs)-1)))
err=[r for r in recs if r[1]=='ERROR']
print("error_count",len(err))
from collections import Counter
print("top code",Counter(r[4] for r in err).most_common(3))
co=[int(r[5]) for r in recs if r[3]=='/api/checkout']
print("checkout n",len(co),"mean",sum(co)/len(co), round(sum(co)/len(co)))
to=[r for r in recs if 'timeout' in r[6]]
print("timeout lines",len(to),"unique users",len(set(r[2] for r in to)))
fat=[r for r in recs if r[1]=='FATAL']
print("first fatal",fat[0], "min ts", min(r[0] for r in fat))
out={"error_count":len(err),
 "top_error_code":Counter(r[4] for r in err).most_common(1)[0][0],
 "checkout_mean_latency_ms":round(sum(co)/len(co)),
 "timeout_unique_users":len(set(r[2] for r in to)),
 "first_fatal_ts":fat[0][0]}
json.dump(out,open('answers.json','w'),indent=2)
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
EOF
